findings.evidence: The hrr-codex delegation says its result is durable in Work, but resultPath still names only .private/hrr-task-result.json in the writer worktree. Neither this latest checkpoint nor HRR-B-CODEX-CANDIDATE provides the retained inputs/codex-candidate-source-result-1033d6f.json address and hash. That complete retained Input exists and its embedded result reproduces the original hash. The immutable 681 selected Task context also does not reach that Input through its dependency/source closure. Native receiver guidance at SKILL.md:27/44 explicitly requires retained source-address recovery rather than relying on a temporary path.
findings.impact: If the producer pane/worktree is unavailable, a new receiver following the latest checkpoint is directed to the temporary original and must rediscover the canonical capture by listing and inspecting unrelated Inputs. There is no demonstrated data loss or replay, but the durable result route is incomplete for the agreed bounded recovery path.
findings.requestedChange: In a new checkpoint or existing Task-owned result routing field, retain the canonical Work Input path/fragment plus its exact blob/hash, original result hash, producer/source Task and commit/tree. Retain the private path as historical origin only. Reference the current independent review Inputs and unresolved holds there. Preserve old checkpoints and all original bytes; no new registry, scheduler or native occurrence is needed.
findings.releaseCondition: Independently read back a successor route, verify its exact current hashes and show that a new receiver can locate this retained result from the selected Work/Task without the producer pane or temporary path.
